sn46.5:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami -pe- ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn46.5:1.5: bodhāya saṃvattantīti kho bhikkhu tasmā bojjhaṅgāti vuccanti.
sn46.5:1.6: idha bhikkhu, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ -pe-
sn46.5:1.7: upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.5:1.8: tassime sattabojjhaṅge bhāvayato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
sn46.5:1.10: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
sn46.5:1.11: bodhāya saṃvattantīti kho bhikkhu, tasmā bojjhaṅgāti vuccantīti.
